messages:
anna.devex: Quick UX callout: compact run history + tool-calling looks cramped on narrow screens. Inline function defs push useful bits below the fold.

sam.ux: Agreed. Idea: collapse long param lists by default and show a concise summary row, e.g. `Show params (2)`.

frank.f: Note: collapsing impacts keyboard nav and performance. Animating height for many runs causes layout thrash. Also watch overlap with tool badges near the ts.

maria.a11y: A11y nits: toggles must include aria-expanded + aria-controls. Badge icon contrast is ~3:1 now; target AA. SR should announce when details open.

tyler.prod: Product needs the last 3 invocations visible without expanding. Can we do a dense row: model | tool | status | mini-ts, expand to full schema?

anna.devex: Proposed: default = compact row (model | tool | status | mini-ts) + "Show details" affordance. Inline expand reveals 1-2 lines of truncated schema, param summary, and an "Open schema" link that opens modal.

sam.ux: Copy: prefer "Show details" not "Expand". For the link, I prefer "Open schema" if it navigates a modal, otherwise "View schema" for inline.

frank.f: DOM plan: `ul.run-list > li.run-item[data-expanded]` using CSS Grid to rearrange columns and switch to a stacked layout <640px. For animations use transform/opacity on an absolute panel to avoid reflow; will prototype.

maria.a11y: Ensure focus moves into expanded content and maintain reading order. Add aria-live for status updates so SR users get tool-call results.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: preview build: `run-history-compact-ui` (#4321) - https://ci.internal/builds/4321 (includes compact rows + basic collapse).

tyler.prod: Acceptance criteria: perceived expand/collapse <200ms, keyboard nav (tab to toggle, enter/space toggles), SR reads header + details, and mobile density test: 3 runs visible on iPhone SE.

anna.devex: I'll add a checklist to the PR + screenshots. Frank, any blockers besides the animation approach?

frank.f: Timing concerns only. Will swap to transform-only animations and add a small debounce for rapid toggles.

maria.a11y: Also: underline or other signifier on the "Open schema" link for users with colorblindness/low-contrast settings.

sam.ux: I'll update mocks and copy, tag @frank.f when Figma is ready.

anna.devex: Thanks all 1 — leaving open for one more pass. I'll run a handheld test once preview is live.
